senses.gloss:
पृच् I. €2 Ā. (पृक्ते, पृक्ण) To come in contact with.
━II. €7 P. (पृणक्ति, पृक्त)
—1 To bring into contact with, join, unite; एवं वदन् दाशरथिरपृणग्धनुषा
 शरम् Bk. 6. 39.
—2 To mix, mingle.
—3 To be in contact with, touch.
—4 To satisfy, fill, satiate.
—5 To augment, increase,
—6 Ved. To give or grant bountifully. ━III. €1 P., €10 U. (पर्चति, पर्चयति-ते)
—1 To touch, come in contact with.
—2 To hinder, oppose.

पृच्छकः [प्रच्छ्-ण्वुल् संप्रसारणम्] An inquirer, an investigator;
 पृच्छकेन सदा भाव्यं पुरुषेण विजानता Pt. 5. 93; Y. 2. 268.

—1 Questioning, asking, inquiring.
—2 An inquiry into the future.
